# LIR cheatsheet (generated by `lir lang --cheatsheet`)

Language surface: 65 supported constructs, 71 reserved words, 131 builtins. Validate with `lir check f.lir --json`; run with `lir run f.lir --backend=vm`.

## Program skeleton

```lir
fn main() -> i64 {
    println("hello")
    return 0
}
```

Exactly one `fn main() -> i64`; its return value is the exit code. Newline-separated statements, braces on every block, no `not`, no `;` between blocks.

| Construct | Canonical form | Notes |
|---|---|---|

| `const_local` | `const NAME = constant_expression` | Compile-time constant usable inside a function body; the value must be knowable at compile time. |

| `while` | `while cond { }` | Pre-test loop. Provide loop progress: an infinite body that freezes its condition variables is rejected, and … |

| `until` | `until cond { }` | Runs the body until the condition becomes true. Prefer 'while !cond' for cross-language readers. |

| `break_continue` | `break continue` | Only inside loops, never inside a 'defer' block, and there are no labelled variants. |
| `return` | `return value return` | A trailing expression without 'return' is also accepted in value functions; explicit 'return' is the canonical … |
| `defer` | `defer statement   defer { block }` | Runs on every exit from the enclosing scope, in LIFO order. break/continue/return are rejected inside a … |
| `guard_else` | `guard cond else { return ... }` | Early-exit helper: the else block must leave the function. It does not bind values and does not support 'guard … |
| `unreachable` | `unreachable` | Marks a path that must not be taken; reaching it traps at runtime. |

## Attributes

| Construct | Canonical form | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `attr_test` | `#[test] fn t() { @assert_eq(1, 1) }` | Marks a test function collected by 'lir test'. Test functions take no parameters and do not need main. |
| `attr_inline` | `#[inline]` | Inline hint for the optimizer. #[cold] is the inverse hint. |
| `attr_cold` | `#[cold]` | Marks a rarely executed function so hot paths stay compact. |
| `attr_pure` | `#[pure] fn f(x: i64) -> i64 { ... }` | Declares a function free of side effects. Calling a printing/allocating builtin inside a pure function is … |
| `attr_pre` | `#[pre(condition)] #[post(condition)]` | Hoare-style contract checked at compile time when arguments are constant (a statically violated call fails … |

## Do not emit (rejected by the compiler)

| Construct | Why / instead |
|---|---|
| `proc` (legacy) | Alias of 'fn' kept for older code. New code must use 'fn'. |
| `pub` (legacy) | Accepted and ignored: LIR has no module privacy; every declaration in an imported file is visible. |
| `extern_ffi` (unsupported) | extern fn / extern "C" blocks |
| `module_file` (unsupported) | mod foo { ... } |
| `var` (legacy) | Legacy synonym of 'let mut'. Prefer 'let mut' so mutation is explicit at the declaration site. |
| `unsafe_block` (unsupported) | unsafe { } |
| `asm_block` (unsupported) | asm("nop") |
| `slice_type` (partial) | s[a..b]  (no slice ranges) |
| `pipe_operator` (unsupported) | 5 \|> 3   \|   x \|> f(...)  (supply the receiver explicitly) |
| `async_await` (unsupported) | async fn / await |
| `float_types` (partial) | let a: f64 = 1   (use 1.0) |

## Reserved words (never identifiers)

`fn`, `let`, `var`, `mut`, `const`, `struct`, `enum`, `trait`, `impl`, `loop`, `match`, `if`, `else`, `while`, `for`, `unless`, `until`, `guard`, `proc`, `in`, `return`, `break`, `continue`, `defer`, `pub`, `mod`, `use`, `import`, `type`, `extern`, `self`, `true`, `false`, `null`, `comptime`, `try`, `panic`, `elif`, `and`, `or`, `i8`, `i16`, `i32`, `i64`, `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64`, `f32`, `f64`, `bool`, `string`, `void`, `unsafe`, `volatile`, `asm`, `align`, `packed`, `union`, `unreachable`, `as`, `isize`, `usize`, `i128`, `u128`, `never`, `dyn`, `spawn`, `async`, `await`, `where`

## Repair loop

```sh
lir check f.lir --json   # status "ok" => valid
lir run f.lir --backend=vm
```

Diagnostics: `code`, `help`, `expect{kind,value}` (`lir.diagnostics.v1`). Codes: `lir explain --list`.
